agent_note: First-person present-tense narration throughout, with a past recollection strand (q06002 remembered exchange, q06017 childhood summers, q06020 remembered scene with the mother, q06031 habitual backstory, q06030 a set-off third-person passage). 27 event quotes, 22 present / 5 past = 81.5% present, which lands in the 80-85% audit band flagged in METHODOLOGY.md; the past minority traces cleanly to memory/backstory, so this reads as 'Present + recollection strand' rather than an unexplained split. Not dual: nothing indicates diary or epistolary form. Quotation marks survive well in this book, so the mark-majority test carried most dialogue calls; q05999, q06024 and q06028 had no marks and were judged on vocative/imperative/direct-address signals. q06011 is verse. Two Ukrainian quotes and one Shelley epigraph discarded as paratext.
